inverter: APsystems EZ1-LV (2 inputs, independent MPPT; 900 VA max output)

certifications.conditions: CSA Certificate of Compliance 80310017 (issued 2026-07-15) certifies the EZ1-LV as a PIPV grid-interactive inverter "interconnected with other subassembly plug-in equipment to form a PIPV System". Conditions: further evaluation is needed when forming a complete system; for use on dedicated circuits (10 A breaker); a listed proprietary latching or locking plug and receptacle (mated pair) per UL 6703; a listed Class A GFCI between the system and any non-dedicated circuit.
CSA Certificate 80196075 (issued 2026-07-14): grid support utility interactive microinverter, models EZ1-LV and DS3-LV, to UL 1741 including Supplement SB and IEEE 1547-2018.

notes: Inverter only: panels are sold separately. The maker's shop lists "Max output power reaching 900VA" and a 5 m power cord. The UL 3700 certificate covers the inverter as a component with installation conditions, not a complete plug-in kit.
